name: cas-expiry-intelligence
description: Standalone CAS & Expiry Intelligence Terminal for NIFTY and BANK NIFTY — analytics only, no order execution.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cas/shared && npm run build -w @cas/api && npm run build -w @cas/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cas/shared && npm run test -w @cas/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cas/shared && npm run lint -w @cas/api && npm run lint -w @cas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cas/api && npm run typecheck -w @cas/web
